verdict.rationale: Lithic documents its own Disputes API, which handles network filing for chargebacks and representment responses, so programmatic dispute filing is a first-party capability. Its Events API offers registrable webhooks, but the evidence never ties them to dispute status changes. Most of the story's specific elements are unevidenced. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, evidence/document submission, provisional credit handling, dispute-specific status webhooks through resolution, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Lithic can help power your cardholders' disputes by handling networking filing for chargebacks and representment responses.
With Lithic Events, you can register and manage webhook URLs, replay webhook messages, control event subscription secrets, and search past events.
